verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud provider, so automatic compute placement is a fair question to ask of it. The only related evidence, "Run your application closer to where your users are," describes placing apps near users, not automatically placing compute near backend data, so it counts only as an adjacent feature. Nothing in the pack documents automatic, data-aware placement for latency optimization.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
